title: Haggai Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Haggai 2: the glory of the later house, the question put to the priests, and the promise to Zerubbabel.

questions.text: How does the text say the people now see this house, compared with its former glory?
questions.explanation: Haggai asks who is left who saw this house in its former glory, and whether it is not in their eyes as nothing.

questions.text: What were Zerubbabel, Joshua and all the people of the land told to do?
questions.explanation: They were told to be strong and work, for Yahweh of Armies says, "I am with you."

questions.text: When does Yahweh say he covenanted this word with them?
questions.explanation: This is the word that he covenanted with them when they came out of Egypt, and his Spirit lived among them.

answers.text: When they came out of Egypt
When the first house was built

questions.text: What does Yahweh of Armies say he will shake?
questions.explanation: He says that in a little while he will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea and the dry land, and he will shake all nations.

answers.text: Only the mountains and the hills of Judah
Only the walls and the gates of Jerusalem
Only the throne of Darius the king
The heavens, the earth, the sea and the dry land

questions.text: What does Yahweh of Armies claim as his own?
questions.explanation: He says, "The silver is mine, and the gold is mine."

questions.text: What does Yahweh promise to give in this place?
questions.explanation: The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former, and in this place Yahweh of Armies says he will give peace.

questions.text: What did the priests answer when asked whether bread, stew, wine, oil or any food touched by the fold of a garment carrying holy meat would become holy?
questions.explanation: When asked whether bread, stew, wine, oil or any food touched by that fold would become holy, the priests answered, "No."

questions.text: What happened when someone came to a heap of twenty measures?
questions.explanation: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures there were only ten, and when one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty there were only twenty.

questions.text: With what did Yahweh strike all the work of their hands?
questions.explanation: Yahweh struck them with blight, mildew and hail in all the work of their hands, yet they did not turn to him.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will make Zerubbabel, his servant?
questions.explanation: In that day Yahweh of Armies will take Zerubbabel, his servant, and make him as a signet, for he has chosen him.
